framings.text: A human-first experience that compounds both the harness and the codebases it serves: you bring an intuition and act as the final judge of a rigorous, durable, verified result that considers the whole forest and makes the next change easier.

supports.quote: system that compounds itself and serves as a meta harness
it should operate like a michellin star resteraunt and I am the resterauntaur that tastes the final delicious product.
not just the trees, but the forest.

outcome: You can start with a brain dump, prompt, hunch, or intuition and later taste a coherent, rigorous, durable, verified result ready for human review—one that respects the whole codebase and makes its next change easier.

alternatives.label: Incremental human-checkpoint workflow
alternatives.benefit: Could preserve your judgment throughout the path while compounding learning from each completed change.
alternatives.cost: May require more deliberate checkpoint design before the experience feels seamless.

alternatives.label: Broad autonomous lifecycle orchestration
alternatives.benefit: Could coordinate more of the continuum from intuition to review-ready result with less manual transition work.
alternatives.cost: Could make consequential design taste harder to inspect or redirect.
